info.title: Crossroads Marketplace
info.description: Provider-neutral B2B commerce. Every API JSON response has exactly one resource object and a status_code matching HTTP; failures use error. Lists live in the resource's items array. Image content remains binary and /openapi.json retains standard OpenAPI structure. Money is integer EUR cents. All agent writes are policy checked; approvals require browser sessions. See docs/api.md for the complete integration guide.
